dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL), not otherwise specified (NOS), non-germinal-center B-cell phenotype by the Hans algorithm (CD10 negative, BCL6 positive, MUM1 positive)

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: Availability and eligibility for clinical trials or molecular profiling (e.g., TP53, MYD88, CD79B), which could inform prognosis but is not required for standard therapy.

dx_not_breast_recurrence.quote: the axillary biopsy shows lymphoma with negative cytokeratin and GATA3, excluding breast cancer recurrence.

stage_iii.quote: Lugano/Ann Arbor stage IIIB: lymph node involvement above and below the diaphragm (left axillary, mediastinal, mesenteric, para-aortic) with splenic involvement

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms (documented fever to 38.4 C and drenching night sweats; weight loss about 3%, below the 10% B-symptom threshold)

stage_bulk_definition.quote: Largest mass is a 7.5 cm mesenteric conglomerate, not bulky by the conventional >=10 cm criterion.

mn_stage_iv.quote: Lugano/Ann Arbor stage IIIB: lymph node involvement above and below the diaphragm

mol_del_not_dh.quote: with a double-expressor immunophenotype (MYC about 45%, BCL2 about 70%) but no MYC, BCL2 or BCL6 rearrangement by FISH (not double-hit/triple-hit)

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: FISH is negative for MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 rearrangements, so this is not a double-hit or triple-hit lymphoma

mn_da_epoch.quote: The phenotype predicts a somewhat inferior PFS/OS than generic DLBCL but does not change standard first-line therapy outside a clinical trial.

prog_ipi_2.quote: IPI 2 (stage III and elevated LDH) = low-intermediate risk; age-adjusted IPI 2 = high-intermediate

prog_cns_ipi_2.quote: CNS-IPI 2 (stage III and elevated LDH; age 59, ECOG 1, no more than one extranodal site, no kidney/adrenal involvement) = intermediate risk, approximately 4-5% at 2 years.

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: I will not give intrathecal chemotherapy or high-dose methotrexate prophylaxis and will not perform a routine lumbar puncture.

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: I will not give intrathecal chemotherapy or high-dose methotrexate prophylaxis and will not perform a routine lumbar puncture.

tx_cardiac_aware_no_full_dox.quote: six R-CHOP cycles will add 300 mg/m2, bringing cumulative doxorubicin to about 540 mg/m2. POLARIX enrolled patients with adequate cardiac function

mn_standard_dox_ignores_heart.quote: Curative-intent R-CHOP x6 every 21 days: rituximab 375 mg/m2 IV day 1, cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2 IV day 1, doxorubicin 50 mg/m2 IV day 1 with dexrazoxane 500 mg/m2

tx_cardio_onc_referral.quote: Before cycle 1 I still want: cardiology consultation with ECG, troponin and BNP/NT-proBNP, and consideration of cardiac MRI to define the cardiomyopathy

tx_cardioprotection.quote: Continue amlodipine, add an ACE inhibitor/ARB and a beta-blocker for LVEF 45%/hypertension per cardiology, and avoid fluid overload.

tx_anthracycline_free_curative.quote: if symptomatic heart failure or LVEF <40% develops, I will switch to a non-anthracycline regimen (e.g., R-CEOP) rather than simply dose-reduce.

tx_cardiac_monitoring.quote: Repeat echocardiogram at the end of therapy and as directed by cardio-oncology.

mn_non_curative.quote: Her stated goal is cure and return to work, so I will treat with curative intent rather than palliate or watch-and-wait.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: end-of-treatment FDG PET/CT 6-8 weeks after cycle 6, interpreted by Lugano 2014/Deauville 5-point criteria.

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Tumor lysis prophylaxis with allopurinol 300 mg daily (renal function is normal) plus IV hydration, with monitoring of potassium, calcium, phosphate, uric acid and creatinine before and 24-48 hours after the first cycles

sup_gcsf.quote: Primary febrile neutropenia prophylaxis with pegfilgrastim 6 mg SC day 2.

sup_anastrozole.quote: Stop anastrozole now, since she is at the planned end of a 10-year course (November 2026) and continuation through cytotoxic therapy adds no benefit.

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: Already completed: staging FDG PET/CT, bone marrow aspirate/biopsy, FISH, IHC, echocardiogram, CBC/CMP/LDH/urate/beta-2 microglobulin, HIV/HBV/HCV serologies, and ECOG status.

fit_curative_ecog1.quote: ECOG 1, age 59, working full-time and independent, with normal renal, hepatic and marrow function; she is fit for curative full-dose immunochemotherapy.

miss_cardiac_workup.quote: Cardiology consultation with baseline ECG, troponin and BNP/NT-proBNP, plus consideration of cardiac MRI to define whether LVEF 45% is anthracycline/radiation-related and to guide heart-failure therapy.
